app.slogan: Get paid in bitcoin or mobile money, in seconds.

inscription.confirmationErreur: The two passwords do not match.
inscription.motDePasseCourt: The password must be at least 12 characters long.

reinit.sousTitre: Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
reinit.succes: Password changed. You can sign in.
reinit.lienInvalide: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

recherche.aide: Type to search across every section.
recherche.bientot: Search arrives with your first sales.

utilisateur.aideVocaleAide: A speaker on every button reads its name aloud.

caisse.coursIndisponible: The bitcoin price is not available right now.
caisse.minimum: The amount must be at least {{min}}.
caisse.panierVide: Tap an item to add it to the cart.
caisse.walletNonConnecte: No wallet connected: bitcoin is unavailable.

vide.titre: Your checkout is on its way
vide.texte: Type an amount, charge in bitcoin or mobile money, and watch the payment land live.

paiement.scanner: The customer scans this code with their bitcoin wallet.
paiement.scannerMobileMoney: The customer scans this code with their phone, or open the payment page on this device.
paiement.qrAria: QR code of the payment request
paiement.verifie: Checked: still waiting for the payment.
paiement.waveTexte: The customer pays with Wave through this link. Once the money has reached your Wave account, the owner or manager confirms the sale.
paiement.confirmerTexte: First check that the money has reached your Wave account. This confirmation is recorded in the audit log.
paiement.expireTexte: No payment was received. Send a new request: it will use the current rate.
paiement.annuleTexte: This sale was cancelled. No payment is expected.
paiement.echoue: The payment did not go through. The customer was not charged.
paiement.introuvable: This payment request cannot be found.
paiement.annulerTexte: The payment request will be closed. If the customer has already paid, the payment will still be recorded.
paiement.copieImpossible: Automatic copy failed. Select the text by hand.

succes.tropPercu: This customer paid twice. Refund the second payment of {{montant}} outside the app.
succes.payeeApresAnnulation: This payment arrived after the sale was cancelled: the money was received, so the sale is marked as paid.
succes.testTermineTexte: The test payment succeeded. Everything works.

recu.introuvableTexte: The link may be incomplete or too old.

ventes.exportErreur: The export could not be downloaded. Try again.

vide.texte: Your sales will show up here from the first charge, with their status and receipt.

tableau.aucuneVentePeriode: No paid sale over this period.

vide.texte: From the first sale, you will see today's total and the bitcoin / mobile money split here, live.

portefeuille.aidePortefeuilles: Alby Hub, Coinos, Primal, Zeus…: in your wallet, create a “Nostr Wallet Connect” connection (with a budget), then paste the link here. SatsPoint never sees your keys.
portefeuille.revoquerTexte: SatsPoint deletes the connection secret. Also remove the connection in your wallet. Bitcoin payments will be blocked until a new connection is made.
portefeuille.destinationAide: Paste an invoice (lnbc…), an address (name@domain) or an LNURL.
portefeuille.soldeInsuffisant: You are {{sats}} short for this transfer.
portefeuille.budgetTexte: The send budget is set in your wallet when connecting.
portefeuille.destinationInvalide: This destination is not recognised. Check the invoice or the address.
portefeuille.paiementIncertain: The transfer is uncertain. Check your wallet before trying again.
portefeuille.cameraIndisponible: The camera is not available on this device: paste the code.
portefeuille.proprietaireSeulement: Only the owner can send sats.

vide.texte: Connect your Lightning wallet to receive payments directly, with no middleman.

equipe.inviterTexte: They will receive a link valid for 72 hours.
equipe.desactiverTexte: Their access is cut immediately, on every device.
equipe.dernierProprietaire: The shop must keep at least one owner.
equipe.roleGerant: Sales, items, team and settings. Cannot send sats.
equipe.roleCaissier: Charges only. Sees their own sales of the day.

vide.titre: You are on your own for now
vide.texte: Invite a cashier or a manager: they charge for you, with no access to your money.

articles.supprimerTexte: The item disappears from the checkout grid. Past sales are kept.
articles.lectureSeule: Read only: only the owner or manager can edit items.

vide.texte: Create your best-selling items to charge in a single tap.

reglages.waveManuelAide: Manual confirmation by the owner or manager.
reglages.messageRecuAide: Shown at the bottom of the customer's receipt.
reglages.waveLienAide: Link of your Wave merchant page (https://pay.wave.com/m/…).
reglages.paytechTexte: Your keys stay encrypted and are never shown again. The money lands in your own PayTech account.
reglages.secretAide: Leave empty to keep the saved value.
reglages.supprimerTexte: Mobile money will be disabled until new keys are entered.

vide.texte: Name, city, payment request duration, maximum amount and receipt message: everything is set here.

demarrage.testExplication: Create a 100 FCFA request and pay it yourself: you will see the green screen and know everything works.
demarrage.termineTexte: Everything works. Charge your first sale.
